rosterRules: 18 rounds: exactly 2 QB, 2 K, 2 TEAM, 6 RB, 6 WR. Weekly start: 1 QB, 3 RB, 3 WR, 1 K, 1 TEAM (WIN or LOSE). Add/drops: $50 fee, same position only, 1-week hold, dropped players locked to buyback.
rulesInsights: NO PPR — receptions are worthless. Only yards-milestones (100/200 rush-rec, 300/400 pass) and distance-tiered TDs score. De-weight catch-volume arguments.
DISTANCE TIERS: 70+ yd TD pass = 25 pts (vs 10 short); 50+ yd rush/rec TD = 20-25; 60+ yd FG = 20 (vs 5 short). Explosiveness >> volume.
KICKER LEG STRENGTH is a scoring multiplier, not a tiebreaker: Aubrey's 60-yd range means his makes are worth 2-4x a short-range kicker's.
WEEKLY HIGH SCORE pays $3,000 x 18 weeks — draft for ceiling, not floor. A boom/bust lineup that spikes one week can out-earn a steady one.
START ONLY 1 QB / 1 K: the #2s are bye-cover + weekly matchup options. Two elite Ks = pick the dome/weather matchup each week.
WAIVERS ARE EXPENSIVE ($50, same-position, buyback lockout, no trades): the drafted roster is nearly final. Late rounds = upside lottery tickets, and R7 QB2 really is the last cheap QB.

TEAM PICKS score the MARGIN: best LOSE candidates by Vegas = ARI (4.5 O/U), MIA (4.5), NYJ (5.5), LV (5.5) — bad teams lose big. R18 Commanders tradition (7.5 O/U) is a mediocre margin play; the R12 pick should be a true blowout candidate.
